name: Lelesia
source:
An elf specialized in spirit magic and fights with a long sword.
She left her home forest and traveled as an adventurer when she met Yoto.
For better or worse, she has an unpretentious personality, and claims to think straight.
When she has sex with Takemoto, she is surprised with how lewd she's become as Yoto teases her about it.

[Translated from [url=https://www.confiture-soft.com/products/elkemo/]Official website[/url]]
